错.consejo: You can describe a mistake or go after a verb.

完.consejo: As a complement it appears after the verb.

写 错.en: write wrong; be wrong when writing
写 错.consejo: He points to the result of writing.

说 错.consejo: He points to the result of talking.

做 错.consejo: He points out that the action goes wrong.

做 完.consejo: It indicates that the task is completed.

写 完.consejo: It indicates that there is nothing left to write.

看 完.consejo: The context clarifies whether you read or see something.

听 完.consejo: It indicates that it is heard to the end.

学 会.es: aprender a hacer; llegar a saber
学 会.en: learn how to do; get to know
学 会.consejo: He points out that a skill is acquired.

准备.consejo: You can refer to preparing something or being ready.

准备 好.en: to be ready; to be ready
准备 好.consejo: - It indicates that the preparation is complete.

texto: The verb is followed by a complement that indicates the result: **写完** = finish writing; **听懂** = understanding when listening; **做错** = doing something wrong.
**完** points out that the action ends; **懂** points to understanding and **错**, an incorrect result. Then **了** and object: **我写完了作业** may appear.

frases.zh: 作业 做 完 了 吗？
frases.en: Wang Ming: Have you finished your duties?
analisis: 作业 做 完 了 吗
Are you done with your homework?

frases.zh: 做 完 了。 这 个 词，我 写 错 了。
frases.es: Carlos: Sí. He escrito mal esta palabra.
frases.en: Carlos: Yes. I've written this word wrong.

frases.zh: 这 个 词 你 看 懂 了 吗？
frases.es: Wang Ming: ¿Has entendido esta palabra al leerla?
frases.en: Wang Ming: Did you understand this word when you read it?
analisis: 看 懂 了 吗
Did you get it when you read it?

frases.zh: 看 懂 了。老师 告诉 我 了。
frases.es: Carlos: Sí, la he entendido. El profesor me lo dijo.
frases.en: Carlos: Yes, I understand. The teacher told me.

frases.zh: 老师 说 得 快，你 听 懂 了 吗？
frases.es: Wang Ming: El profesor habla deprisa; ¿lo entendiste al escucharlo?
frases.en: Wang Ming: The teacher speaks quickly; did you understand when you heard him?
analisis: 听 懂 了 吗
Did you understand when you heard?

frases.zh: 没有，我 没有 听 懂。
frases.es: Carlos: No, no lo entendí al escucharlo.
frases.en: Carlos: No, I didn't get it when I heard it.
analisis: I didn't understand when I heard

frases.zh: 我 昨天 看 完 书 了。
frases.es: Ayer terminé de leer el libro.
frases.en: I finished reading the book yesterday.
analisis: 看 完 书 了

frases.zh: 王明 写 完 了 作业。
我 写 错 了 一 个 词。
frases.es: Me equivoqué al escribir una palabra.
frases.en: I was wrong to write a word.

frases.zh: 老师 说 错 了。
我 做 完 了。
我 学 会 说 这 个 词 了。
frases.es: He aprendido a decir esta palabra.
frases.en: I have learned to say this word.

frases.zh: 我 准备 好 考试 了。
frases.es: Ya estoy preparado para el examen.
frases.en: I'm already ready for the test.

bloques.frase: 我 看 完 了 书。

opciones.explicacion: It indicates that I just read it.

opciones.texto: I understand the book when I hear it.

bloques.frase: 我 ___ 了 作业，可以 休息 了。

opciones.explicacion: Doing the duties and finishing them fits the context.
It means understanding when reading or looking.

bloques.audio: 我 没有 听 懂。

opciones.texto: He didn't understand what he heard.

bloques.frase: 我 写 错 了 这 个 词
老师 说 得 很 慢。

opciones.explicacion: - It's a sign of the end.

opciones.texto: The teacher understood when he heard.

bloques.frase: 我 ___ 了 这 个 词，现在 会 用 了。

opciones.explicacion: It means I learned to use it.
It means I'm done doing something.

intro: The result supplements show which result has an action: end, understand or be wrong.
